prompt: Create a transparent 2-column x 1-row atlas containing only the straight-down TOP orthographic plan of two separate reinforced palisade post caps. Cell 1 left = north-cap source; cell 2 right = west-cap source. Use each corresponding source as the exact object identity and timber/steel material. Camera directly above looking down the vertical post axis. Show only the compact polygonal pointed timber cap footprint from above, a small central wood apex/faceted top, square dark-metal band footprint and compact square earth/ground footprint. Hide all vertical timber shafts, front-facing metal bands, side faces and full pointed stake elevations. The entire plan should be compact and square, approximately 1:1 footprint, not an upright post, not a top-front oblique icon. Each cell contains a single isolated cap footprint with transparent alpha-zero background, no scene or shadows, generous gutters.
